summary: Iteration 3: verified real-PDF upload E2E, month-over-month trend deltas from /api/projects, and frontend trend arrow badges. Backend pytest suite extended to 15 tests — all pass (100%). Real Table-6 PDFs for 2026-04 and 2026-05 upload cleanly with projects_processed=3 each; UPSERT is confirmed idempotent (re-uploading 2026-04 keeps NH-48-CB-2024 history rows for that month at 1). Trend deltas correct (NH-48-CB-2024 progress_delta=4.4, cost_delta=0.0; seeded PRJ-2026-001 progress_delta=16.5, cost_delta=37.5). Frontend Project Explorer renders 11 rows with 11 progress-trend badges (green good) and 8 cost-trend badges (red bad). NH-48-CB-2024 correctly hides the cost badge (delta=0). Filter dropdowns populate (9/8/10). Data Management UI upload works end-to-end (status: 'Report processed successfully.'). Dashboard, Alerts, Detail pages regression-passed.

issues: Chart card renders with an odd circular clip/animation shape on first paint before the recharts BarChart appears — bars are not visible in a full-page screenshot. Data is present via API and previous iteration reported chart working; possibly a CSS clip-path/animation on .chart-card.trend. Verify in the browser interactively.

action_items: Investigate .chart-card.trend styling on the project detail page — the historical progress BarChart appears with a circular clip/overlay in screenshots (data loads correctly, may be purely cosmetic on initial render).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/upload still calls store_pdf (external object storage) BEFORE parsing — if storage is down, valid uploads fail. Consider parsing first, storing on success only.
Trend query in /api/projects is fine but re-uses the ranked CTE twice — small perf improvement possible by pivoting rn=1/rn=2 in a single pass.
App.js remains a single 32-line highly dense file; readability suffers, though functionally correct. Splitting into per-page files would help future maintenance.
Frontend Projects component silently swallows API errors into empty state (`.catch(()=>setData({projects:[],filters:{}}))`) — real 5xx failures look identical to an empty portfolio.
Trend component correctly hides on |delta| < 0.05 and inverts semantics for cost (up = bad, red). Verified visually for both seeded and uploaded projects.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded real fixture PDFs for 2026-04 and 2026-05 (idempotent UPSERT). No net new projects created beyond the 3 already present (NH-48-CB-2024, ZJT-AR-P2, RVNL-RK-BG-19) + 8 seeded PRJ-2026-001..008 = 11 total.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has 15 pytest tests including real-PDF E2E, trend delta, and UPSERT idempotency. Fixture generator at /app/backend/tests/make_table6_pdf.py supports months 2026-04 and 2026-05 only (extend MONTH_DATA dict for others). Total projects in Supabase now = 11. Historical progress chart on /projects/:code renders oddly in screenshots — worth an interactive check.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found in this iteration.
